modules.name: Projects

slides.title: 📁 Projects — Plan, Manage & Complete Every Project
slides.caption:
🗂️ Create Different Types of Projects — Manage personal, business, home, school, travel, financial, event, renovation, learning or family projects separately.
🪜 Plan the Complete Project — Define objectives, phases, milestones, tasks, priorities, start dates, deadlines and project status.
👥 Share & Collaborate — Add family, friends, employees, partners or other people, assign responsibilities and track who is doing what.
💰 Plan & Track Your Budget — Set the project budget, record expenses and payments, attach receipts and compare budget vs actual cost.
📄 Keep Everything Connected — Maintain documents, photos, notes, meetings, tasks, expenses, reminders and important project information together.

✨ Create → Plan → Budget → Collaborate → Track → Complete — manage every project from idea to finish.

modules.name: Vacations
modules.desc: Plan trips with itineraries, budgets and checklists, then track what you actually spend along the way.

slides.title: ✈️ Travel Planning — Plan Your Complete Trip in One Place
slides.caption:
🗺️ Plan Your Entire Journey — Create your trip with destinations, dates, itinerary, activities, places to visit, transportation and daily plans.
💰 Create & Track Your Travel Budget — Plan budgets for flights, hotels, food, transportation, shopping and activities, then compare planned vs actual expenses.
🎫 Manage All Your Bookings — Keep flights, hotels, trains, rental cars, tours, attractions and restaurant bookings organized with dates, times and confirmation details.
📄 Keep Travel Documents Together — Store passports, visas, tickets, boarding passes, hotel confirmations, insurance, receipts and other important travel documents with your trip.
📊 Track Everything During & After the Trip — Record expenses, attach receipts, manage shared/split expenses and see total trip cost, budget remaining and complete travel history.

✨ Dream → Plan → Budget → Book → Travel → Track Expenses → Keep Memories & Documents — your complete trip in one place.

modules.name: Notes
modules.desc: Capture ideas, journals and quick notes in rich text — organised and always with you.

slides.title: 📂 My Organizer — Everything Important in One Place
slides.caption:
🗂️ Create Your Own Folders — Organize information into folders like Personal, Family, Finance, Health, Business, School, Travel, Home or anything you choose.
📄 Keep Your Documents — Store important PDFs, bills, receipts, certificates, agreements, manuals, IDs and other documents where you can easily find them.
📝 Save Notes & Ideas — Maintain notes, lists, ideas, instructions, important information and things you want to remember.
🍳 Build Your Recipe Collection — Save your favorite recipes, ingredients, cooking instructions, photos and personal notes in your own organized folders.
📸 Keep Different Content Together — Maintain documents, notes, photos, recipes and attachments under the right folders instead of having information scattered everywhere.

✨ Folders → Documents → Notes → Photos → Recipes → Everything organized and easy to find.

modules.name: Contacts
modules.desc: Keep the people in your life in one place, with the details and shared history that matter.

slides.title: 🌟 Daily Habits — Build Better Routines for the Whole Family
slides.caption:
✅ Create & Track Daily Habits — Maintain habits like brushing teeth, drinking water, reading, exercise, homework, sleep, healthy eating and screen-time limits.
📅 Record Every Day — Simply mark each habit as completed, missed or partially completed and build your daily history.
📊 See Your Success Rate — Automatically see daily, weekly and monthly completion percentages, streaks and progress for every habit.
💡 Get Help Choosing Good Habits — Pick from suggested habits for health, fitness, learning, productivity, self-care, finance and everyday routines instead of creating everything yourself.
🧒 Make It Kids-Friendly — Give kids simple age-appropriate habits, let them check off their own progress, build streaks and celebrate achievements—helping them learn consistency in a fun way.

✨ Choose a habit → Do it daily → Record it → Build your streak → See your success → Create better routines.

slides.title: 🎟️ Events — Discover, Plan & Never Miss What’s Happening
slides.caption:
🔍 Browse Events Around You — Discover concerts, exhibitions, festivals, sports, shows, workshops, conferences and family/kids events.
➕ Add Events Manually — Found an event somewhere else? Simply enter the event name, date, time, venue, location, ticket details and other information.
❤️ Save What Interests You — Keep interesting events in your list even before deciding to attend, so you can come back to them later.
⏰ Never Miss an Event — Add events to your schedule and receive reminders for ticket sales, booking deadlines, event dates and start times.
🎫 Keep Everything Together — Once you decide to go, maintain tickets, bookings, expenses, documents, notes, friends/family attending and related plans with the event.

✨ Discover → Save → Plan → Book → Get Reminded → Enjoy — never miss an event you care about.

slides.title: 📔 My Daily Planner — Capture Your Day, Your Way
slides.caption:
📝 Write Anything About Your Day — Keep daily notes about what happened, what you did, thoughts, experiences and things you want to remember.
💡 Capture Ideas Instantly — Got a new idea, plan, business thought or something you want to try? Record it before you forget.
😊 Record Feelings & Moments — Capture your mood, feelings, gratitude, achievements, challenges and special moments throughout the day.
📸 Add Photos & Memories — Take or upload photos of food, places, activities, family moments, purchases, events or anything meaningful.
🏷️ Organize Your Daily Life — Categorize entries like Food, Idea, Feeling, Memory, Work, Family, Health, Finance or Personal, then look back at your days anytime.

✨ Write → Capture → Feel → Photograph → Remember — your everyday life, all in one personal planner.

slides.title: 📚 My Library — Your Complete Reading World in One Place
slides.caption:
📖 Maintain All Your Books — Keep school books, textbooks, novels, personal books, reference books, eBooks and digital books organized in your own library.
🎒 Organize School & Personal Reading — Separate books by school year, subject, category, author, genre or your own collections.
🪪 Keep Your Library Cards — Maintain public, school, university or other library memberships, including card details, expiry dates and related information.
📊 Track What You Read — Mark books as Want to Read → Reading → Completed, track reading progress and keep ratings, notes and favorite learnings.
🔔 Manage Borrowed Books — Record books you borrow, lend or reserve, track due dates and set reminders so books are returned on time.

✨ School Books → Personal Books → Digital Books → Library Cards → Reading Progress → Your lifelong library.

slides.title: 🔄 Lend & Borrow — Never Lose Track
slides.caption:
Track anything you lend to or borrow from friends—books, money, games, tools or other items. Select people directly from your friend list, add return dates/reminders, and quickly check who has your stuff and what you need to return.

✨ Lend → Borrow → Track → Remind → Return — nothing gets forgotten or lost.

modules.name: Kids finances
modules.desc: Give kids their own money space — allowance, savings and a first, safe taste of real finance.

slides.title: 👨‍👩‍👧 Long-Distance & Separated Parenting — Stay Connected Around Your Child
slides.caption:
Manage important child information between parents in one organized place — school, health, activities, schedules, expenses, travel, emergency information and important contacts. 📄 Keep documents and records together, 💬 maintain parenting-related messages and discussions, and use an approval/request process for things like trips, activities, schedule changes or shared expenses. Maintain a clear history of requests, approvals, decisions and shared information so both parents can stay informed and focused on the child.

modules.name: Kids finances
modules.desc: Give kids their own money space — allowance, savings and a first, safe taste of real finance.

slides.title: 💰 Shared Parenting Finances — Clear & Organized
slides.caption:
Define a monthly budget for your child and plan how expenses will be shared between parents. Track school, healthcare, activities, childcare, travel, clothing and other monthly expenses, along with upcoming payables. See who paid what, each parent’s share, outstanding amounts and complete payment history.

✨ Budget → Expenses → Parent Share → Payables → Payments → Clear monthly picture.

modules.name: Parenting and approvals
modules.desc: Approve your kids permissions, purchases and decisions — stay informed without hovering.

slides.title: ✅ Parenting Approval Process — Request, Decide & Follow Through
slides.caption:
📤 Send for Approval — Create a request for travel, school activities, medical decisions, expenses, schedule changes, events, documents or other child-related matters.
📋 See All Approval Activities — Keep Pending, Approved, Rejected and Changes Requested items together with dates, messages, documents and decision history.
💬 Discuss Before Deciding — Parents can add comments, questions, supporting documents and important information directly to the request.
👍 Approve & Create the Action Plan — Once approved, automatically maintain the related tasks, appointments, payments, bookings, reminders and responsibilities.
📚 Keep the Complete History — Preserve Request → Discussion → Documents → Approval → Tasks → Completion for future reference.

✨ Ask → Discuss → Approve → Act → Complete — clear coordination around every important parenting decision.

features.name: Business

slides.title: 🏢 My Businesses — Manage Every Business, Big or Small
slides.caption:

💰 Teach Kids How Business Works — Let kids create a simple business such as lemonade sales, crafts, tutoring or lawn care and learn by doing.

🏦 Manage the Complete Business — Connect bank accounts, customers, vendors, assets, inventory, payables, receivables, transactions and documents to the right business.
📈 See How Each Business Is Performing — Understand revenue, expenses, profit, assets and liabilities while keeping every business separate and organized.

✨ Create → Sell → Spend → Earn → Learn → Grow — from a kid’s first small business to your growing company.

slides.title: 🏢 Business Profile — Keep Every Business Detail Organized
slides.caption:
📋 Maintain Complete Business Information — Keep business name, type, registration details, addresses, contact information, tax details and other important information together.
👥 Track Owners & Key People — Maintain owners, partners, shareholders, directors, employees and other important contacts associated with the business.
📄 Keep Business Documents Together — Store incorporation documents, registrations, licenses, agreements, tax documents, certificates and other important records.
📅 Never Miss Important Dates — Track registration renewals, licenses, insurance, tax deadlines, contracts and other important business dates.
🔗 Connect the Entire Business — Keep related bank accounts, assets, loans, insurance, customers, vendors, employees, transactions, payables and receivables connected to the correct business.

✨ Business Details → Owners → Documents → Important Dates → Finances — your complete business record in one place.

modules.name: Business partners
modules.desc: Manage customers, vendors and clients in one place, with every transaction linked back to them.

slides.title: 🤝 Business Partners, Customers & Vendors — Keep Every Relationship Organized
slides.caption:

🧑‍💼 Manage Your Customers — Maintain customer profiles with contact information, transactions, sales, invoices, receivables and payment history.

💰 See the Complete Financial Relationship — Know how much you sold, purchased, paid, received, owe or are still waiting to receive for each customer or vendor.
📄 Everything Connected to the Right Person or Business — Keep transactions, invoices, receipts, documents, tasks, notes and communication details connected to the related partner, customer or vendor.

modules.name: Leads and CRM
modules.desc: Track leads through your pipeline from first contact to closed deal.

slides.title: 🎯 Sales CRM — Turn New Leads Into Customers
slides.caption:
🧲 Capture Every New Lead — Add potential customers with their name, company, contact details, source, requirement and expected opportunity.
🔄 Track the Sales Journey — Move leads through your own stages such as New Lead → Contacted → Follow-up → Proposal → Negotiation → Won/Lost.
✅ Manage Follow-ups & Tasks — Create calls, meetings, reminders, notes and next actions so no sales opportunity gets forgotten.
💰 Track Opportunities & Potential Revenue — Maintain expected deal value, probability, products/services and expected closing date to understand your sales pipeline.
🤝 Convert Lead to Customer — Once the deal is won, convert the lead into a Customer and continue with quotes, sales, invoices, receivables, payments, transactions and documents.

✨ Lead → Follow-up → Opportunity → Deal → Customer → Revenue — manage your complete sales journey in one place.

slides.title: 📈 Lead Progress — From First Contact to Customer
slides.caption:
🎯 Track Every Lead Stage — Follow each opportunity through New Lead → Contacted → Meeting → Proposal → Negotiation → Won/Lost.
📅 Manage Meetings & Follow-ups — Record calls, meetings, appointments, next actions and reminders so no lead gets forgotten.
📝 Keep Complete Interaction History — Maintain notes, discussions, requirements, decisions and follow-up history for every lead.
📄 Keep Documents Connected — Attach proposals, quotations, presentations, agreements, emails and other important documents directly to the lead.
🤝 Convert Lead to Customer — When the deal is won, simply convert the lead into a Customer and carry important information forward for sales, invoices, receivables, payments and future business.

✨ Lead → Follow-up → Meeting → Documents → Deal → Customer — track the complete journey.

slides.caption:

✨ Employee → Job → Salary → Attendance → Leave → Tasks → Documents → Performance → Complete employment journey.

slides.title: 📈 Lead Progress — From First Contact to Customer
slides.caption:

slides.title: ⏱️ Employee Timesheet — Track Time, Tasks & Approvals
slides.caption:

📅 See the Complete Weekly View — View Monday to Sunday hours, daily totals, task-wise hours, overtime and total weekly working hours.

slides.title: 📈 Employee Promotion & Termination — Track Every Career Change
slides.caption:
🚀 Manage Promotions — Record new job title, position, department, manager, grade and promotion effective date.
💰 Connect Compensation Changes — When promoted, maintain the employee’s new salary, compensation components and effective date while preserving previous salary history.
🔄 Track Transfers & Role Changes — Maintain department transfers, manager changes, location changes and other employment movements.
🚪 Manage Resignation & Termination — Record resignation/termination date, last working day, reason, notice period, final settlement and exit status.
📄 Keep Complete Employment History — Attach promotion letters, salary revision letters, resignation letters, termination documents, exit documents and notes to the employee.

✨ Join → Grow → Promote → Transfer → Compensation Change → Exit — preserve the employee’s complete journey.

modules.name: Sales flow
modules.desc: Quotation to Sales Order to Delivery to Invoice to Payment, with every step posted to your books.

slides.title: 🛒 Sales Order & Quotation — Sell Products and Services Easily
slides.caption:
📝 Create Professional Quotations — Build quotations for products, services, quantities, prices, discounts, taxes, terms and validity dates.
📦 Sell Products & Services — Add physical products, service items, packages or custom charges to the same quotation or sales order.
✅ Convert Quotation to Sales Order — Once the customer approves, convert the quotation directly into a Sales Order without entering everything again.
💰 Track Order Value & Customer Commitments — Maintain order amount, taxes, discounts, payment terms, delivery/service dates and customer details.
📄 Keep the Complete Sales Record Connected — Store quotation, sales order, invoices, payments, receivables, documents and customer history together.

✨ Quotation → Customer Approval → Sales Order → Product/Service Delivery → Invoice → Payment — complete sales flow in one place.

slides.title: 🔄 End-to-End Sales Flow — From Order to Payment
slides.caption:
🛒 Create Sales Order — Confirm the customer’s products/services, quantities, prices, discounts, taxes, payment terms and delivery details.
📦 Fulfill & Deliver — Track product delivery or service completion, including partial deliveries, delivery dates and status.
🧾 Generate Customer Invoice — Create the invoice directly from the order/delivery, so you don’t have to enter the same information again.
💰 Track Payment & Receivable — Know exactly how much was invoiced, received, partially paid and still outstanding, including the receiving bank account.
🔗 Keep the Complete Journey Connected — See the entire history with quotation, order, delivery, invoice, payment, transactions, receipts and documents connected together.

✨ Quotation → Sales Order → Delivery/Service → Invoice → Receivable → Payment → Complete.

modules.name: Inventory
modules.desc: Track raw materials, finished goods and services — stock levels, costs and valuation, always current.

slides.title: 📦 Inventory Management — Raw Materials, Finished Goods & Services
slides.caption:
🧱 Maintain Raw Materials — Track materials, components, supplies and other items you purchase and use to produce your products.
🏭 Maintain Finished Goods — Keep all products you manufacture or sell with quantity, cost, selling price, stock and availability.
🛠️ Maintain Services — Create service items with service name, category, rate, tax and pricing, ready to use in quotations, sales orders and invoices.
🔄 Track Inventory Movement — Know what was purchased → received → consumed → produced → sold → delivered, with stock automatically updated.
📊 Know Your Inventory Position — See available stock, inventory value, low-stock items and complete movement history for every item.

✨ Raw Material → Production → Finished Goods → Sales → Delivery — while services stay connected to your complete sales flow.

modules.name: Invoice
modules.desc: Track raw materials, finished goods and services — stock levels, costs and valuation, always current.

slides.title: 🧾 Invoices, Payments & Tax — Complete Billing in One Place
slides.caption:
📄 Create & Manage Invoices — Generate invoices directly from sales orders, products or services with customer, quantity, price, discounts and payment terms.
🧮 Calculate Taxes — Apply the appropriate tax rates and tax components, and clearly see subtotal, tax and final invoice amount.
💰 Track Customer Payments — Record full or partial payments, payment dates, methods and the bank account where the money was received.
⏳ Know What’s Outstanding — Instantly see Paid, Partially Paid, Overdue and Unpaid invoices, along with the remaining receivable.
📊 Maintain Tax & Payment History — Keep invoices, taxes, payments, transactions, receipts and supporting documents connected for easier reporting and future reference.

✨ Invoice → Tax → Receivable → Payment → Bank Transaction → Complete financial record.

modules.name: Chart of Account
modules.desc: A full, real double-entry chart of accounts behind every transaction you make.

slides.title: 🛒 Purchase Flow — From Requirement to Vendor Payment
slides.caption:
📝 Create Purchase Requirement / Order — Select the vendor, raw materials, products or services, quantity, price, taxes, delivery date and payment terms.
📦 Receive Goods or Services — Record full or partial receipts, received quantities and service completion while automatically updating inventory where applicable.
🧾 Record Vendor Invoice — Connect the vendor invoice directly to the purchase order and goods/service receipt and verify quantity, price and tax.
💰 Create Payable & Make Payment — Know exactly how much you owe, when it is due and which bank account will pay it. Track full or partial payments.
🔗 Keep the Complete Purchase History — Maintain vendor → purchase order → receipt → invoice → tax → payable → payment → bank transaction → documents as one connected flow.

✨ Requirement → Purchase Order → Receive → Vendor Invoice → Payable → Payment → Complete.

modules.name: Menstruation

slides.title: 🌸 Menstruation & Cycle Tracking — Why It Matters
slides.caption:
🩸 Track Your Period — Record start dates, duration, and flow intensity to understand your cycle better.
📅 Know What’s Coming — Estimate your next period, fertile window, and ovulation days so you can plan ahead.
😊 Understand Your Body — Track moods, symptoms, energy, and changes throughout different phases of your cycle.
📊 Discover Your Patterns — Compare cycle length, period duration, flow, and symptoms across months to spot changes over time.
💕 Keep Your Cycle History Together — Maintain your complete menstrual history in one place, making it easier to understand and discuss with your healthcare provider when needed.

slides.title: 🩸 Cycle Detail — Day by Day
slides.caption:
🩸 Track Daily Flow — Record light, medium, heavy, or very heavy flow for each period day.

📅 See Your Current Cycle — Quickly know your start date, current cycle day, estimated end date, and days remaining.
🌸 Know Your Ovulation Window — View estimated ovulation start and end dates to understand your current cycle phase.
📊 Build a Detailed Cycle Record — Save day-by-day information to create a useful history of your menstrual patterns over time.

🛍️ Save Things From Stores — Found something you like? Keep the product, store, price, photo, link and notes in your wish list for later.
✈️ Not Just Things to Buy — Add wishes like travel somewhere, attend a concert, try an activity, learn a skill, visit a restaurant or do something with family.
📅 Turn a Wish Into a Plan — When you’re ready, add a budget, target date, savings goal, tasks and reminders and start working toward it.
❤️ Track Your Wish Journey — Move wishes through Wish → Planning → Doing → Completed, while keeping photos, documents, expenses and memories connected.

✨ See it → Wish it → Save it → Plan it → Do it → Remember it.
